messages:
elaine: Quick heads-up — I opened a vendor/lockfile bump PR that needs a small branch handoff before RC cutoff tomorrow 16:00 PT. It updates `third_party/vendor` and splits the submodule so CI doesn’t rebuild the whole tree. PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4521

pranav: Thanks — what's the impact on the public SDK builds? Do we need to pin any transitive deps?

sophie: Also can we get a one-line changelog blurb? release notes pipeline expects a short entry from the PR.

elaine: SDKs should be unaffected, but there is one transitive bump (libhttp 2.4 -> 2.5) that caused a flaky test on arm64. I added a compatibility shim in the patch.

jorge: CI shows an intermittent failure in `pkg/streamer` on linux-arm64, looks like a timeout when the new libhttp sets a lower default keepalive. I left a comment on the PR with stack traces.

ci-bot: Check run failed — `linux-arm64 / integration` — flake detected. https://ci.redwood.internal/build/98765 (logs attached) :warning:

maya: I can take the submodule split and run a local smoke matrix on my mac and an arm64 VM in the lab. Will report back within the hour. :+1:

elaine: Thanks @maya. If that passes we can land the split first, then the main bump in a follow-up so we keep the merge window small. My proposed commands: ```bash
# create split branch
git checkout -b vendor/split-submodule
git rm -r third_party/vendor && git commit -m "split vendor submodule"
# push and open PR
git push origin vendor/split-submodule
```

pranav: For the changelog, here's a suggested line you can paste into the PR: "Vendor: bump libhttp to 2.5 (fixes keepalive regression on arm64); split vendor submodule to reduce CI rebuilds."

elaine: Perfect — pasted that into the PR description. Also added the `release:precutoff` label.

maya: Quick update: local arm64 VM reproduced the timeout twice but after applying the shim from the PR it was stable. Also ran `./scripts/smoke.sh --matrix=small` — all green.

jorge: Great. Can someone add the manual approval for the arm64 job? I don't want the bot to auto-retry until we're sure.

elaine: @pranav @sophie can one of you give the final approval so we can land the split branch? I'd like to merge before lunch to leave time for the main bump.

pranav: Approved. I'll watch the post-merge build.

ci-bot: Merge queued — vendor/split-submodule into main. Post-merge checks will run.

elaine: After the split lands I'll open the follow-up bump PR (smaller diff). Will add a note to the release board and ping on #release-ops if anything flaps. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
